Inertial frame of reference.question: The _____ was Fundamental concept of classical mechanics.
Inertial frame of reference.fact: In classical physics and special relativity, an inertial frame of reference (also called an inertial space or a Galilean reference frame) is a frame of reference in which objects exhibit inertia: they remain at rest or in uniform motion relative to the frame until acted upon by external forces.

Inertial frame of reference.subject: Indian Demographics & Census
Inertial frame of reference.question: In such a frame, an object with zero net force acting on it, is perceived to move with a constant velocity, or, equivalently, _____'s first law of motion holds
Inertial frame of reference.fact: In such a frame, an object with zero net force acting on it, is perceived to move with a constant velocity, or, equivalently, Newton's first law of motion holds. Some physicists, like Isaac Newton, originally thought that one of these frames was absolute — the one approximated by the fixed stars.

Inertial frame of reference.subject: Indian Demographics & Census
Inertial frame of reference.question: Some physicists, like _____, originally thought that one of these frames was absolute — the one approximated by the fixed stars
Inertial frame of reference.fact: Some physicists, like Isaac Newton, originally thought that one of these frames was absolute — the one approximated by the fixed stars.

Inertial frame of reference.question: The Coriolis effect can deflect certain forms of motion as seen from _____, and the centrifugal force will reduce the effective gravity at the equator
Inertial frame of reference.fact: Due to Earth's rotation, its surface is not an inertial frame of reference. The Coriolis effect can deflect certain forms of motion as seen from Earth, and the centrifugal force will reduce the effective gravity at the equator.

Inertial frame of reference.subject: Indian Demographics & Census
Inertial frame of reference.question: Nevertheless, for many applications the _____ is an adequate approximation of an inertial reference frame
Inertial frame of reference.fact: Due to Earth's rotation, its surface is not an inertial frame of reference. The Coriolis effect can deflect certain forms of motion as seen from Earth, and the centrifugal force will reduce the effective gravity at the equator.

Inertial frame of reference.question: This fact represents the essence of the _____ principle of relativity: The laws of mechanics have the same form in all inertial frames
Inertial frame of reference.fact: This fact represents the essence of the Galilean principle of relativity: The laws of mechanics have the same form in all inertial frames.

Inertial frame of reference.question: However, this definition of inertial frames is understood to apply in the _____ realm and ignores relativistic effects
Inertial frame of reference.fact: However, this definition of inertial frames is understood to apply in the Newtonian realm and ignores relativistic effects.

Inertial frame of reference.subject: Indian Demographics & Census
Inertial frame of reference.question: In Newtonian mechanics, inertial frames of reference are related by the _____ group of symmetries
Inertial frame of reference.fact: In Newtonian mechanics, inertial frames of reference are related by the Galilean group of symmetries.

Inertial frame of reference.subject: Indian Demographics & Census
Inertial frame of reference.question: However, some "relativists", even at the time of _____, felt that absolute space was a defect of the formulation, and should be replaced

Inertial frame of reference.question: However, the principle of special relativity generalizes the notion of an inertial frame to include all physical laws, not simply _____'s first law

However, the principle of special relativity generalizes the notion of an inertial frame to include all physical laws, not simply Newton's first law.

Inertial frame of reference.subject: Indian Demographics & Census
Inertial frame of reference.question: Newtonian inertial frames transform among each other according to the _____ group of symmetries
Inertial frame of reference.fact: Newtonian inertial frames transform among each other according to the Galilean group of symmetries.

Inertial frame of reference.question: In his frame of reference, _____ defines the spot where he is standing as the origin, the road as the x-axis, and the direction in front of him as the positive y-axis
